lineage: S101 was profitable overall but its three-asset short sleeve lost. A disclosed post-hoc instrument ablation found ETH-only short positive while BTC and SOL shorts were negative. S102 freezes that narrow selection without changing S101's global regime, long rules or risk parameters.

architecture.global_regime: Byte-identical to S101 asymmetric UP/DOWN/SIDEWAYS classifier.
architecture.up_execution: Byte-identical to S101: six-asset S99-style long momentum book, with market OI attention only scaling exposure.
architecture.down_execution: Byte-identical S101 short rules but ETHUSDT is the only permitted short instrument: below EMA50, negative 28d and 84d momentum, mean funding >= -0.0001, OI EMA7/EMA28 spread >= +0.05%.
architecture.decision_frequency: Weekly at UTC open; strictly prior data only.

data.source: checksum-verified public Binance USD-M 1d, funding and 5m metrics archives

decision_policy.historical: Report profitability, costs, drawdown, time slices, short sleeve and all checks, but never label the selected history independent OOS.
decision_policy.paper_forward: Eligible only if base, stress and severe full replay are positive, total ETH short-sleeve stress PnL is positive, and at least 15 weekly short decisions occurred. Then observe from 2026-10-19 for at least 180 days and 26 weekly decisions; no early live promotion.

disclosures: ETH was selected after inspecting S101 short ablations, creating material selection bias.
The historical replay can reject S102 but cannot validate it for live capital.
No S102 parameter may change after this file is hashed.
